info.name: Postman API Tests
info.description:
Import this collection together with the matching environment file.

Recommended usage:
- Set baseUrl to your local or deployed API URL
- Login with the role-specific requests to populate tokens
- Use managementToken for endpoints that allow Admin or Enterprise
- Use the dedicated role tokens for Citizen, Collector, Enterprise, and Admin folders
- For task-specific runs, keep only the endpoints related to the Jira key in the task description

Task mapping:
- KIEM-4: Auth APIs
- KIEM-14: Collector APIs and Collector Task APIs
- KIEM-16: Enterprise API task assignment/progress endpoints
- KIEM-17: Enterprise reward rule endpoints
- KIEM-19: Notifications APIs and real-time task flow

This collection covers health, auth, public endpoints, reports, complaints, notifications, citizen flows, collector flows, enterprise flows, and admin flows.
